issues.message: CHK-001 userSees may be too abstract (does not contain specific output text in quotes). Should describe the exact text the user sees, not descriptions like "feature works correctly"

3 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Add an ADDITIVE resume mode to experiments/pos-instrument-replay/run-batch.mjs: on --resume (or POS_RESUME=1), read the existing batch-ledger.jsonl, skip iterationIds already recorded (proof OR stop), run only the remaining iterations, ignore/repair a truncated trailing line, and have the strict exact-multiset end-of-run guard reconcile the FINAL ledger (== protocol cross-product, 0 dup / 0 gap). The fresh-campaign path (empty/no ledger) must be UNCHANGED so M2 batch-ledger.jsonl + selfcheck-m2 stay valid + Build experiments/pos-instrument-replay/resume-probe.mjs (committed producer): spawn run-batch (small scale) and kill it deterministically TWICE — (a) at a frozen iteration boundary (SIGKILL after K iterations recorded), (b) mid-iteration via the crash hook POS_FAIL_APPEND_AT (after workspace write, before ledger append) — restart in --resume mode after each, and write resume-reconciliation.json with the pre/post-kill ledger diff, identity-multiset comparison, dup/gap counts (must be 0/0), and casualty disposition are performed simultaneously?)

understanding still has 1 undigested unknowns: Whether a mid-append truncated line actually occurs under POS_FAIL_APPEND_AT (the fault throws before write vs during) — resolved by the probe run; resume must be robust either way.
